# FreeStyle Control Center **Extends the HyperOS FreeStyle control center so you can style every tile your way.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - Add any tile, or change an existing one, to a different tile style - Expandable media player - Extended power menu (also works on Xiaomi.eu ROMs) - 5G tile and Restart SystemUI tile - Glass blur for every tile style on HyperOS 4 ## Requirements - HyperOS 3 or HyperOS 4 - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - Android 15+: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module. ## Screenshots

FreeStyle Control Center

Extends the HyperOS FreeStyle control center so you can style every tile your way.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • Add any tile, or change an existing one, to a different tile style
  • Expandable media player
  • Extended power menu (also works on Xiaomi.eu ROMs)
  • 5G tile and Restart SystemUI tile
  • Glass blur for every tile style on HyperOS 4

    • Requirements

  • HyperOS 3 or HyperOS 4
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FreeStyle-Control-Center/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • Android 15+: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module.
